title: Video Player All Format
summary: The ultimate HD video player with all the advanced features you need.
description:
Looking for the perfect video player? Look no further! Video Player All Format is a beautifully designed, powerful, and completely FREE HD video player built for Android.  Enjoy a seamless playback experience with stunning clarity, whether you're watching movies, TV shows, or home videos.

Experience the Difference:

Video Player All Format supports all your favorite video formats, from standard definition to stunning 4K Ultra HD.  Enjoy crystal-clear playback and smooth performance, even with high-resolution files.  We've packed this player with features designed to enhance your viewing pleasure:

* Universal Compatibility: Play virtually any video format, including MP4, MOV, M4V, MKV, WMV, RMVB, FLV, AVI, 3GP, TS, and more.
* Enhanced Viewing:  Immerse yourself with PAN and ZOOM functionality, and enjoy crisp HD and 4K video playback.
* Personalized Playlists: Create and manage your own video playlists, adding your favorite videos for quick and easy access.
* Total File Control: Organize your videos with our built-in file explorer, complete with CUT, COPY, and PASTE functionality.
* Advanced Playback Controls: Fine-tune your viewing experience with features like video resume, adjustable playback speed (0.5x to 3.0x), night mode, and a sleep timer.
* Multitasking Made Easy: Watch videos in a convenient pop-up window while using other apps.
* Superior Sound: Customize your audio with the built-in equalizer, adjusting treble and voice clarity for optimal listening.
* Privacy Protection: Secure your personal videos with the Video Locker feature.
* Subtitle Support: Download subtitles for your favorite movies and shows.
* Built-in Editing Tools: Trim videos, extract audio, and convert video files to MP3 with our integrated video cutter and converter.
* Powerful Music Playback: Enjoy a robust music player experience with a 5-band equalizer and bass boost.
* Big Screen Entertainment: Cast your videos to your TV with Chromecast.
* Smart File Management: Quickly find and delete duplicate video files to free up valuable storage space.
* Intuitive Controls:  Easily control brightness and volume with simple gestures.
* Background Play: Listen to your videos like music with background playback.


Download Video Player All Format today and enjoy the ultimate video playback experience on your Android device!  Send feature requests and suggestions to arunnanthalath@gmail.com.
